_comment: The idfon adapter for a talk-radio station (docs/live-radio.md). It carries only transport concerns and points at the station's own programme file; `scripts/radio-program.mjs config` writes a per-instance copy with absolute paths. backend=stream pumps the programme into a one-way live call; voice_route.mode=broadcast tells callers the holder only sends audio, so the app dials a listen call instead of a text turn. `log` gets one JSONL line per second plus every slot change and any agent-side stall. `public: true` (written from the roster entry) makes the holder accept the subject-less ticket the page hands out; without it only `scripts/radio-admit.sh` tickets are accepted.
